🧩 The Video Director Workflowis here — a powerful system for chaining multiple AI-generated videos into one continuous sequence.

Thisbasic versionincludes everything you need to start creating smooth, multi-part AI videos using the“last frame → first frame”method.


🎥 Watch the Full Tutorial

⚙️ What It Does

✅ Generate4 connected scenesthat transition seamlessly
✅ Regenerate or tweak individual sequences without restarting the whole project
✅ Build continuous storytelling withconsistent character appearance and motion
✅ Output your scenes as separate videos ready for post-processing

🚀 Perfect For

  • AI video creators who want to test multi-sequence generation

  • Those working with Wan 2.1 / 2.2 or Flux-based video models

  • Anyone wanting a flexible base for cinematic projects or animated LoRAs

💡 How It Works

The workflow uses a smart system to connect the end of one clip to the start of the next.
Simply set your sequence count, prompts, and run!
No manual frame blending, no scene loss, no re-rendering everything from scratch.
